mapper.select: SELECT A.REG_CODE regCode, A.ORG_CODE orgCode, A.PRODID prodId, A.PRODNAME prodname FROM CHB_PRDRESIST_CODE A INNER JOIN CHB_EQUDET_IMP_TMP B ON A.ORG_CODE = B.ORG_CODE AND A.PRODID = B.ACCOUNT
SELECT * FROM CHB_PRDRESIST_CODE B where B.PRODID = #{prodid}

SELECT count(1) from CHB_PRDRESIST_CODE where PRODID = #{prodid}
and ORG_CODE = #{orgCode}

SELECT DISTINCT A.REG_CODE id, nvl(b.prod_name,a.reg_code) text FROM CHB_PRDRESIST_CODE A left join chb_prd_baseinfo b on b.prod_id = a.PRODID
A.REG_CODE is not null
and A.REG_CODE like concat(concat('%', #{search}),'%') or b.PROD_NAME like concat(concat('%', #{search}),'%')
#{orgCode}
ORDER BY A.REG_CODE
SELECT DISTINCT B.REG_CODE id, B.REG_CODE text FROM CHB_PRDRESIST_CODE B where B.REG_CODE is not null order by B.REG_CODE

SELECT p.prod_id,p.prod_name FROM chb_prd_baseinfo p where p.status in ('E','M') and p.fprod_id is null
AND P.PROD_ID LIKE concat(concat('%', #{search}),'%')
